LESSON: POLITE SPEAKING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Polite SPEAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Polite SPEAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests in and out of school. making requests, excusing self
2. Use appropriate vocabulary to excuse self and apologize in and out of school. 14
3. State the appropriate vocabulary for excusing self and making requests in and out of school. on making requests, excusing
4. Appreciate making requests, excusing self and apologizing when need arises. situations in school and at home. demonstrating situations for making requests, excusing self and apologizing. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration, learning to learn

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests in and out of school. making requests, excusing self
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate vocabulary when making requests in and out of school. making requests, excusing self. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Use appropriate vocabulary to excuse self and apologize in and out of school. 14
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate vocabulary to excuse self and apologize in and out of school. 14. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. State the appropriate vocabulary for excusing self and making requests in and out of school. on making requests, excusing
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state the appropriate vocabulary for excusing self and making requests in and out of school. on making requests, excusing. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. Appreciate making requests, excusing self and apologizing when need arises. situations in school and at home. demonstrating situations for making requests, excusing self and apologizing. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration, learning to learn
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate making requests, excusing self and apologizing when need arises. situations in school and at home. demonstrating situations for making requests, excusing self and apologizing. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration, learning to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Polite SPEAKING.
2. Explain Polite SPEAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Polite SPEAKING.
4. Show that you can: Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests in and out of school. making requests, excusing self
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Polite SPEAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Polite SPEAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests in and out of school. making requests, excusing self
2. Use appropriate vocabulary to excuse self and apologize in and out of school. 14
3. State the appropriate vocabulary for excusing self and making requests in and out of school. on making requests, excusing
4. Appreciate making requests, excusing self and apologizing when need arises. situations in school and at home. demonstrating situations for making requests, excusing self and apologizing. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration, learning to learn

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
